qualification.details: Manager (Coordination): MBA from a reputed and recognized Institute/ University with specialization in General Management. Minimum 3 years' Post-qualification experience in a reputed company, preferably PSUs. Preference will be given to those with experience in Coordination with Govt. agencies, E-Office/E-file systems, attending to LA questions, etc., with strong interpersonal and communication skills in Malayalam and English. Accounts Officer: CA/ICMA Inter passed with completion of Articleship as per the mandatory requirements of the respective Institutes OR M.Com. Minimum 2 years Post-Articleship experience in a reputed company, preferably PSUs. OR Minimum 3 years post-qualification experience in the field of accounting and finance functions such as GST filing, IT filing, day-to-day accounts operations using advanced Tally or equivalent software up to the level of finalization of accounts, attending to internal/statutory audit, coordination with banks/FIs, clients, etc. The candidate should possess thorough knowledge of working in a computerised environment with proficiency in MS Office, social media management & AI tools, market research/intelligence and field study.

faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application for the Kerala Cashew Board Recruitment 2026 is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Manager (Coordination) and Accounts Officer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the Kerala Cashew Board for the posts of Manager (Coordination) and Accounts Officer.

faq.answer: For the Manager (Coordination) post, candidates must possess an MBA in General Management from a recognized institute or university.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Accounts Officer position is 30 years. Candidates should ensure they meet this criterion before applying.

faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Manager (Coordination) post will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.answer: The application mode for this Kerala Cashew Board recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the application form on the official website.

faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview. An additional selection process may be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.answer: For the Accounts Officer post, a minimum of 2 years post-articleship experience or 3 years post-qualification experience in accounting and finance is required.
